profile.address: Lancium Clean Campus, 5502 Spinks Rd, Abilene, Taylor County, TX 79603
profile.reading:
Crusoe's Abilene campus, on the Lancium Clean Campus north of Abilene, Texas, is the first site of the Stargate venture of OpenAI, Oracle and SoftBank. Crusoe began construction in mid 2024. Its first two 100 MW buildings were energized in under a year and serve Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, which runs the systems for OpenAI.

A second phase of six more buildings brings the campus to 1.2 GW and is due for completion by the end of 2026, per Crusoe. On 27 March 2026 Crusoe announced a separate 900 MW campus next door for Microsoft, with two buildings and an on-site power plant, which it says takes the full Abilene site to about 2.1 GW. The first building there is expected to be energized in mid 2027.

The 1.2 GW figure is the campus power capacity stated by Crusoe, not measured IT load. Coordinates are a street-level geocode of Spinks Road, not of the building footprint.

reading.body:
Abilene is the clearest case that AI capacity is now a power project, not a computing one: two 100 MW buildings energized in under a year, with 1.2 GW planned on the original campus and 900 MW more next door.

The pattern is speed tied to electricity. Crusoe broke ground in mid 2024 and had the first two buildings energized within a year, which is fast for a data center and only possible because the site sits on the Lancium Clean Campus, where power is the product being delivered. The 1.2 GW figure is Crusoe's stated campus capacity, not measured IT load, so it describes how much power the site is built to draw rather than how much computation it performs.

The Microsoft addition matters for a different reason. A separate 900 MW campus with its own on-site power plant, announced 27 March 2026 and expected to energize its first building in mid 2027, takes the full Abilene site to about 2.1 GW. Two hyperscalers are now siting in the same Texas county, and the constraint they are both working against is the same one.

What this does not tell you is actual consumption. Every number here is planned or stated capacity, and the coordinates are a street-level geocode of Spinks Road, not a building footprint. It also does not say where the power comes from, what it costs, or whether the 2026 and 2027 dates hold.
